stderr 'panic/main\.lgo'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/constswitchlabels

go 1.27

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func pick[T any](v T, skip bool) int {
	_ = v
	n := -1
	const switch T {
	case int, string:
		if skip {
			goto done
		}
	_:
		n = 1
	done:
		n += 10
	}
	return n
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(pick[int](0, false))
	fmt.Println(pick[string]("s", true))
	fmt.Println(pick[float64](0.0, false))
}

-- w/panic/main.lgo --
package main

func boom[T any](v T) int {
	_ = v
	const switch T {
	case int, string:
		goto done
	done:
		panic("boom")
	}
	return 0
}

func main() {
	println(boom[int](0))
}
